name: notes-whiteboard-lines
description: Whiteboards keep their line breaks: the expanded Notes panel's read-only agent note renders a three-line note as three visual lines. The collapsed whiteboard is a count line rather than a preview (design-system.md section 12), so there is no collapsed line count to guard.

allowlist..summary: The case prefixes disclosure.module.css's classes to disclosure-*, so its summary and the notes bar's summary are distinct selectors here.
allowlist..chevron: Same prefixing: Disclosure's chevron and the notes bar's leading chevron box resolve to different selectors.

mutation.note: Deleted and re-run on 2026-11-24: without pre-wrap the 3-line agent note renders 1 visual line. Restored, the case passes again.
